promise: DC Studios scheduled Superman: Legacy for a US theatrical release on July 11, 2025.
description: The January 31, 2023 slate scheduled Superman: Legacy for July 11, 2025 in US theaters. Released as Superman, the film opened on the planned weekend; contemporary box-office reporting confirms the completed opening.
evidence: DC's original slate and movie page establish the July 11 US release target.
Associated Press reported the completed opening weekend on July 13, 2025, rather than merely repeating a future release schedule.
